claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Bifonazole at 2.5 uM is expected to be largely inactive against human cancer cell lines, since its antifungal azole activity requires fungal CYP51 and its reported mammalian effects (hexokinase detachment, calmodulin antagonism, CYP inhibition) occur at higher concentrations or are cytostatic rather than cytotoxic.
